tools.name: farmbrite_list_animals
tools.description: List livestock records (name, type, tag number, gender, breed, status, weight, group, purchase/sale data). Farmbrite returns only active-status animals unless you filter by status (Sold, Deceased, Culled, Butchered, Archived...). GET /animals.

tools.name: farmbrite_get_animal
tools.description: One animal by id, with its current location and custom fields. GET /animals/{animal_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_livestock_groups
tools.description: List livestock groups (id, name, type). GET /livestock_groups.

tools.name: farmbrite_get_livestock_group
tools.description: One livestock group by id with its member count, filters and member animals. GET /livestock_groups/{group_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_animal_measurements
tools.description: Weight, height, temperature, condition score and fecal-count records of one animal, newest data included. GET /animals/{animal_id}/measurements.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_feedings
tools.description: Feeding records (amount, cost, date, feed type, inventory used) of one animal or livestock group. GET /{animals|livestock_groups}/{id}/feedings.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_grazing_summary
tools.description: Grazing status per field/pasture: animals present, days rested, rest days required, last grazed. GET /grazings.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_plants
tools.description: List plant types/varieties (days to maturity, spacing, market price, harvest unit). GET /plants.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_crops
tools.description: List crop plantings (plant, field/plot, bed, quantity, planting and expected harvest dates, growth stage). GET /crops.

tools.name: farmbrite_get_crop
tools.description: One crop planting by id. GET /crops/{crop_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_plots
tools.description: List fields/grow locations (title, type, size, status, grazing rest days). GET /plots.

tools.name: farmbrite_get_plot
tools.description: One field/grow location by id. GET /plots/{plot_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_harvests
tools.description: Harvest records (quantity, unit, grade, price, date, inventory added) of one animal or crop planting. GET /{animals|crops}/{id}/harvests.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_treatments
tools.description: Treatment records (type, product, amount, cost, date, withdrawal date, technician) of one animal, field or crop planting. GET /{animals|plots|crops}/{id}/treatments.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_notes
tools.description: Notes (description, category, date, keywords) attached to an animal, field, plant type, crop planting or inventory type. GET /{animals|plots|plants|crops|inventory_types}/{id}/notes.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers, suppliers, vendors): name, company, email, phone, type, label. GET /contacts.

tools.name: farmbrite_get_contact
tools.description: One contact by id, with address. GET /contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks (title, description, status, priority, assignee, due/end time, checklist, linked animal/field/crop). GET /tasks.

tools.name: farmbrite_get_task
tools.description: One task by id with its checklist. GET /tasks/{task_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_activities
tools.description: List calendar/schedule activities (title, start and end time, all-day flag, linked animal or field). GET /activities.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_inventory_types
tools.description: List inventory item types (feed, supplies, harvested products) with the quantity remaining, unit, value and low-stock alert level. GET /inventory_types.

tools.name: farmbrite_get_inventory_type
tools.description: One inventory item type by id with quantity remaining and projected empty date. GET /inventory_types/{inventory_type_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_get_inventory_locations
tools.description: Where one inventory item is stored: warehouse and bin ids and names, capacity and quantity remaining in each. Use the ids with farmbrite_add_inventory / farmbrite_remove_inventory. GET /inventory_types/{inventory_type_id}/inventory.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_warehouses
tools.description: List storage locations (warehouses) for inventory: name, description, internal id. Use the ids when adding or removing inventory. GET /warehouses.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_orders
tools.description: List sales orders (status, payment status, total, dates, contact, delivery type, invoice number). GET /orders.

tools.name: farmbrite_get_order
tools.description: One order by id with its line items, customer contact, delivery address and totals. GET /orders/{order_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_list_transactions
tools.description: List income and expense transactions (type, amount, date, vendor, category, linked animal/field/plant, description). GET /transactions.

tools.name: farmbrite_get_transaction
tools.description: One transaction by id. GET /transactions/{transaction_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact (customer, supplier, vendor). Nothing is emailed or sent to the contact. Creating twice makes two contacts. POST /contacts.

tools.name: farmbrite_update_contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing contact (only the fields you pass are sent). Overwrites the previous values. PUT /contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task, optionally linked to an animal, equipment, plant, location or planting. May notify the assigned Farmbrite user according to your account settings. Creating twice makes two tasks. POST /tasks.

tools.name: farmbrite_update_task
tools.description: WRITE: change a task (only the fields you pass are sent); set complete=true to mark it done. Overwrites previous values. PUT /tasks/{task_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_transaction
tools.description: WRITE: record an income or expense transaction in the farm's books. Creating twice records it twice. POST /transactions.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to an animal, livestock group, field, plant type, crop planting or inventory item. Notes cannot be removed with this server. POST /{parent}/{id}/notes.

tools.name: farmbrite_add_inventory
tools.description: WRITE: add stock to an inventory item in a storage location (warehouse, optionally a bin). Raises the quantity remaining; not idempotent: repeating adds again. Find ids with farmbrite_list_inventory_types, farmbrite_get_inventory_locations and farmbrite_list_warehouses. PUT /inventory_types/{id}/inv

tools.name: farmbrite_remove_inventory
tools.description: WRITE: take stock out of an inventory item in a storage location (use, loss, sale). Lowers the quantity remaining; not idempotent: repeating removes again. It cannot be undone with this server except by adding stock back. PUT /inventory_types/{id}/inventory/remove.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_order
tools.description: WRITE: create a sales order with line items (status defaults to Draft and payment_status to Due unless you set them; memo is internal, note is customer-facing). Farmbrite may email the customer or generate an invoice depending on the account's settings and the status chosen; the API reference does n

tools.name: farmbrite_update_order
tools.description: WRITE: change an order's status and/or payment status (for example mark it Paid or Delivered). Farmbrite may send customer notifications on some status changes, depending on the account settings. PUT /orders/{order_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_animal
tools.description: WRITE: add an animal (or a group when is_group=true with group_qty) to the herd. type (e.g. Cattle, Sheep) and status are required. Creating twice makes two animals. POST /animals.

tools.name: farmbrite_update_animal
tools.description: WRITE: change an animal's fields (only the fields you pass are sent), including its status (Sold, Deceased, Culled...). Statuses Butchered, Culled and Deceased need death_date. Overwrites previous values. PUT /animals/{animal_id}.

tools.name: farmbrite_add_animal_measurement
tools.description: WRITE: record a measurement for one animal (weight, height, temperature, condition score, fecal egg count). Adds a record each time. POST /animals/{animal_id}/measurements.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_feeding
tools.description: WRITE: record a feeding for an animal or livestock group. Either name the feed type, or give inventory_id + inventory_location_id to draw it from inventory (which lowers that inventory's quantity). Adds a record each time. POST /{animals|livestock_groups}/{id}/feedings.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_harvest
tools.description: WRITE: record a harvest (quantity and unit) for an animal or crop planting. Adds a record each time. POST /{animals|crops}/{id}/harvests.

tools.name: farmbrite_create_treatment
tools.description: WRITE: record a treatment (vaccine, dewormer, spray, fertilizer...) for an animal, livestock group, field or crop planting. Adds a record each time. POST /{animals|livestock_groups|plots|crops}/{id}/treatments.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: farmbrite_list_feedings, farmbrite_list_contacts, farmbrite_list_inventory_types · Private data: farmbrite_list_animals, farmbrite_list_animal_measurements, farmbrite_list_feedings, farmbrite_list_harvests, farmbrite_list_treatments, farmbrite_list_contacts, farmbrite_get_contact, farmbrite_list_orders, farmbrite_get_order, farmbrite_create_contact, farmbrite_update_contact, farmbrite_create_transaction, farmbrite_add_animal_measurement, farmbrite_create_feeding, farmbrite_create_harvest, farmbrite_create_treatment · Public sink: farmbrite_list_contacts, farmbrite_create_contact, farmbrite_create_task, farmbrite_create_transaction, farmbrite_create_note, farmbrite_create_order, farmbrite_update_order, farmbrite_create_animal, farmbrite_add_animal_measurement, farmbrite_create_feeding, farmbrite_create_harvest, farmbrite_create_treatment · Destructive: farmbrite_remove_inventory.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: farmbrite_list_feedings, farmbrite_list_contacts, farmbrite_list_inventory_types · Private data: farmbrite_list_animals, farmbrite_list_animal_measurements, farmbrite_list_feedings, farmbrite_list_harvests, farmbrite_list_treatments, farmbrite_list_contacts, farmbrite_get_contact, farmbrite_list_orders, farmbrite_get_order, farmbrite_create_contact, farmbrite_update_contact, farmbrite_create_transaction, farmbrite_add_animal_measurement, farmbrite_create_feeding, farmbrite_create_harvest, farmbrite_create_treatment · Public sink: farmbrite_list_contacts, farmbrite_create_contact, farmbrite_create_task, farmbrite_create_transaction, farmbrite_create_note, farmbrite_create_order, farmbrite_update_order, farmbrite_create_animal, farmbrite_add_animal_measurement, farmbrite_create_feeding, farmbrite_create_harvest, farmbrite_create_treatment · Destructive: farmbrite_remove_inventory

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
